description: An AzureCLI task with a service connection in the verify stage is rejected.

patches.replace:
- task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: sneaky
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: sc-demo-nonprod
              scriptType: bash
              scriptLocation: inlineScript
              inlineScript: az account show
            target:
              commands: restricted
              settableVariables: none
          - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
            displayName: Publish platform-inputs
